correctness.rationale: Curvature feasibility and support-area identity derive the exact weighted quadratic optimization. Gcd sampling proves the nondivisible norm certificate, split into d=3 square averaging and d≥5 endpoint extreme choices. Elementary rational bounds show κ²>r² for every pair. Strict gap forces all equality cases. For all divisible pairs, Chebyshev derivative bound proves the explicit mixed profile is feasible on the full circle and area improves by a strictly positive exact quantity. Standard-library checker replay passed with finite tests clearly separate from proof.

originality.rationale: Two primary full mathematical comparator records were examined in their original RESULT.md statements, and three geometric primary sources were assessed at available material depth. Existing m=3n exact optimization is stronger only on that resonant subclass and does not imply new exact nondivisible minima, or the all-odd-frequency if-and-only-if criterion. A superficially similar Caratheodory-Fejer theorem optimizes another objective. An inaccessible but plausible earlier SDP manuscript and unindexed results present residual priority risks; originality is passed relative to actually inspected evidence, not asserted absolutely.
residual_risks: The full Bayen–Henrion primary manuscript was inaccessible, despite bounded open-access attempts; definitive same-object overlap there remains unverified.
Unindexed historical Chebyshev minimax, support-function and two-frequency shape-optimization results could state an equivalent broader result.
The current claim is only the arithmetic improvement criterion and nondivisible sharp value; exact divisible maxima (including m=3n) have prior literature.

value.rationale: The theorem gives a complete infinite arithmetic phase separation between exact no-gain and strict-gain of a natural second support harmonic under constant width; for every no-gain pair it supplies a sharp value, exact fixed-axis equality classification and explicit stability. It extends beyond the existing resonant m=3n full optimization by classifying every odd-frequency pair. This is meaningful shape-optimization structure, not a mere reexpression of the support-area Fourier formula.
